summary: Frontend-only verification of the new WEB PANEL Maid-subscription booking UX that reuses the normal Booking cart + /book checkout. All 5 requested scenarios PASS. (1) On /service/svc-maid-fulltime the words 'upfront' / 'pay upfront' are gone; new description 'Book a verified maid on a recurring plan…' is present. (2) Plan picker renders sub-plan-daily/weekly/monthly + sub-subscribe-btn, and no inline sub-start-date / sub-time-input / subscription-checkout dialog exists on the service page (all counts = 0). (3) Selecting Weekly and clicking Book Now navigates to /book which renders <SubscriptionCheckout> (data-testid subscription-checkout) with plan summary 'Full-time Maid' + 'Weekly' + 'Total payable ₹2,200', sub-start-date, sub-time-input, saved sub-address-<id> for the customer's 'Home · 12 MG Road' address, and sub-confirm-pay-btn. (4) Clicking sub-confirm-pay-btn does NOT crash / blank the page — subscription-checkout stays rendered (count=1 after 15s of polling), which is the documented PASS condition for the un-configured payment gateway. (5) Normal non-subscription booking still works: cart cleared, opened Door Repair service, 'Book Now' added to cart, /book rendered the multi-step checkout with step-services=1, checkout-next=1, subscription-checkout=0.

integration_issues.issue: No visible sonner toast was captured after clicking sub-confirm-pay-btn in the un-configured Razorpay TEST env. Page does NOT crash (subscription-checkout still rendered), which meets the PASS criteria in the review request, but the graceful error toast ('Razorpay TEST MODE… not fully configured' / 'Payment gateway is not configured') was not observed via DOM MutationObserver over 15s. Likely either the toast is auto-dismissed very quickly OR openCheckout() resolves falsy without surfacing a user-facing toast. Minor UX gap — main agent may want to ensure a toast is always fired when openCheckout returns falsy so the user sees why nothing happened.

action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: In SubscriptionCheckout.placeOrder, if openCheckout() returns falsy (payment cancelled / gateway not configured), surface a toast.info/toast.error so the user isn't left staring at the button — currently the page stays rendered (good, no crash) but silently.
critical_code_review_comments: SubscriptionCheckout.jsx is clean and well-scoped (~170 lines). Good separation from the normal MultiStep checkout via Checkout.jsx early-return.

SubscriptionPlansPanel.book() correctly calls addSubscription(svc, plan) then navigate('/book'). CartContext.addService reciprocally clears any subscription line, so cart-mixing is prevented — verified in practice (cleared cart + Door Repair → step-services renders, not subscription-checkout).
Minor: consider showing a toast when openCheckout resolves falsy, otherwise the Confirm & Pay silent no-op looks like a dead button.
